recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless the work group later asks for a separate search parameter or additional narrative; adding a duplicate Organization-specific period child or redundant prose would risk drifting from the ExtendedContactDetail datatype source of truth.
issue_request: FHIR-27005 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for R5 asking that Organization contacts be able to carry the period during which the contact fulfilled a role. Its final resolution says FHIR-29034's update of Organization.contact to ExtendedContactDetail satisfies the request because ExtendedContactDetail has a period element.
initial_application: The request was applied through the ExtendedContactDetail migration: a9d7aa77e88c7070371eabb413aa4f91101d07fb changed Organization.contact from BackboneElement to ExtendedContactDetail, 276625857dcd2e40ebf6e01ada8cf5e4c0d9b60b refined related Organization and datatype narrative, and e1320848bd2700338a2a11b634693d52f9fb8ad1 retained the contact migration while removing deprecated top-level Organization telecom/address elements.
additional_context: FHIR-29035 created ExtendedContactDetail with period 0..1 Period, and FHIR-29034 is already represented on the combined branch by no-change audit commit 05d270cd91a76b0b14e1a906810d5137bba4c28e. PA minutes from 2021-12-01 record Organization.contact moving to ExtendedContactDetail and then FHIR-27005 being addressed by the prior trackers. Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active source already satisfies the issue: source/fhir.ini includes Organization and ExtendedContactDetail in build scope, source/organization/structuredefinition-Organization.xml defines Organization.contact as 0..* ExtendedContactDetail, and source/datatypes/extendedcontactdetail.xml defines ExtendedContactDetail.period as 0..1 Period.

related_jiras.note: Published/Persuasive Organization change that moved Organization.contact to ExtendedContactDetail and is already reconciled on the combined branch.
